approach.title: Intelligence separated into responsibilities, not reduced to a single output.
approach.description: ÖTÜKEN AI is being developed around a systems approach that keeps information origin, state across time and authority to act distinct.

items.title: Local and inspectable operation
items.description: System components are designed to operate without making external services a mandatory destination for data or decision flows.

items.title: Information that retains its origin
items.description: A claim is more than text. It is considered together with its source, time, transformation history and confidence.

items.title: State across time
items.description: Identity is not the same as instantaneous state. Change, history and uncertainty are represented separately.

items.title: Authority before action
items.description: Prediction, proposal, decision, authorization and execution are not the same operation.

items.title: Evidence-led engineering
items.description: Progress is assessed through testing, reproducibility and verification gates rather than claims alone.

system.title: Separated responsibilities. Controlled integrity.
system.description: Five high-level areas form the public view of the system.
system.notice: This view is a public abstraction of ÖTÜKEN AI’s responsibility areas, not an implementation architecture or data-flow diagram.

items.title: Computation and Model
items.description: The computation and model foundation designed for local operability, efficiency and inspectable execution.

items.title: Memory and State
items.description: Representation of information, history, entities, change and uncertainty as distinct concepts across time.

items.title: Planning and Tools
items.description: The layer that decomposes goals into controlled steps and treats tool interactions as bounded tasks.

items.title: Authority and Evaluation
items.description: The control and evaluation approach that prevents an output from automatically becoming a decision or authority to act.

items.title: Data and Integration
items.description: The integration approach that preserves data origin, transformation history and boundaries between systems.

principleSet.title: Principles that keep meaning, time, origin and authority distinct.
principleSet.description: These principles guide how the system should reason in the presence of uncertainty and action.

items.title: Layered Zero
items.essence: A value is not the same as absence, unknown, unobserved or conflict.
items.description: A system should not collapse zero, absence, unknown, not yet observed and conflicting evidence into a single meaning.

items.title: Vertical Time
items.essence: Identity is not an instantaneous state; persistent entities are understood through change over time.
items.description: A person, object or system is more than its current snapshot. Identity, state history and changes should remain distinct.

items.title: Provenance-Bearing Information
items.essence: Information is not source-less text; it retains provenance, lineage and knowledge time.
items.description: Where a claim came from, how it was transformed and when it could have been known are part of its meaning.

items.title: Layered Judgment
items.essence: Prediction, proposal, decision, authorization and execution are separate.
items.description: A model output does not authorize itself. Clear boundaries must exist between producing information, making a decision and taking action.

trustSet.title: Trust is built through process, not output alone.
trustSet.description: At ÖTÜKEN AI, trust means retaining information origin, keeping uncertainty visible, separating decision from action and treating human oversight as part of the system boundary.

items.title: Data sovereignty
items.description: Where data is processed, where it is transferred and within which system boundaries it remains are fundamental design considerations.

items.title: Keeping the unknown visible
items.description: Rather than presenting false certainty in the presence of incomplete information, the system is designed to represent unknowns and conflicts explicitly.

items.title: No automatic authority
items.description: A prediction or proposal does not automatically become a decision or authority to act.

items.title: Controlled public disclosure
items.description: Public communication explains the approach and values without publishing implementation details that could weaken security, intellectual property or system integrity.

status.title: Research and engineering in progress
